title: ShatterOS
tagline: Open one room on several devices and use each screen as a window into one continuous physics world.
stateNote: Runs locally on Node. You calibrate by measuring your screens.
problem: Choreographed multi-screen illusions need special software. ShatterOS lets any phones and laptops on your Wi-Fi act as one canvas.
audience: People with a few spare screens and a ruler.
contribution: It is my project: a Node server with a room code, calibration step and a physics playground.
worksToday: Join the same room on several devices, calibrate with a ruler and arrange the screens on a desk map, per the README.
limitations: You need devices on the same network.

involve.headline: Got spare screens?
asks: Try it with a couple of devices and tell me where the calibration confuses you.
